# Ranjit Rajan — Webflow & Frontend Developer
> Portfolio and professional specifications for Ranjit Rajan, co-founder of Cocaimo in Kochi, Kerala, India.

## About
Ranjit Rajan is a Webflow and frontend developer and co-founder of Cocaimo, a web development and digital marketing agency based in Kochi, Kerala, India (09°58'N 76°17'E). He works directly with clients on design, development, and SEO.

## Core Capabilities
- Webflow & Custom Websites (Figma-to-Webflow, Client-First system, custom script integrations)
- Dynamic Content Population through CMS (Sanity CMS, Webflow Collections, multi-reference architectures)
- Speed & Performance (Sub-second load times, Core Web Vitals 95+, minimal DOM, asset budgeting)
- SEO-Ready Builds (Clean Schema.org markup, OpenGraph metadata, structured headings, JSON-LD)

## Primary Toolkit
Webflow, React, TypeScript, Sanity CMS, HTML/CSS/JS, Figma

## Key Projects
- Cocaimo.com: Agency website built in React and TypeScript with SEO structure and schema markup. URL: https://www.cocaimo.com
- Kerala Travel Concierge: Luxury travel brand website with Sanity CMS for self-serve content pipelines and booking flows.
- Aura Salon & Spa: High-conversion booking website with localized CMS, custom JavaScript calendars, and SMS automations.
